claims.sourceText: S. 2226 as engrossed, Division M, Sec. 1102(f)(2), GPO
claims.text: Sec. 1102(f)(2) made the independent research and development disallowance applicable 'with respect to funding from amounts appropriated before, on, or after' the effective date.

claims.nodeLabel: IAA FY2024 Sec. 1102 - contractor turn-in of 'non-earth origin or exotic' UAP material
claims.sourceText: S. 2226 as engrossed, Division M, Sec. 1102(d)(2)(B), GPO
claims.text: Sec. 1102(d)(2)(B) required contractors to provide 'a comprehensive list of all non-earth origin or exotic unidentified anomalous phenomena material.'

claims.nodeLabel: IAA FY2024 Sec. 1102 - contractor turn-in of 'non-earth origin or exotic' UAP material
claims.sourceText: S. 2226 as engrossed, Division M, Sec. 1102(b)(2), GPO
claims.text: Sec. 1102(b)(2) states the sense of Congress that the Government 'must expand awareness about any historical exotic technology antecedents previously provided by the Federal Government for research and development purposes.'

claims.sourceText: S. 2226 as engrossed, Division M, Sec. 1102(c)(6), GPO
claims.text: Sec. 1102(c)(6) reached 'any aerospace craft that uses propulsion technology other than chemical propellants, solar power, or electric ion thrust.'

claims.sourceText: S. 2226 as engrossed, Division M, Sec. 1102(e), GPO
claims.text: Sec. 1102(e) granted immunity: 'No criminal or civil action may lie or be maintained in any Federal or State court against any person for receiving material or information described in subsection (d) if that person complies.'

claims.sourceText: S. 2226 as engrossed, Division M, Sec. 1102(d), GPO
claims.text: Senate-passed IAA FY2024 Sec. 1102(d) required any current or former Federal contractor holding such material to notify the AARO Director within 60 days and within 180 days provide 'a comprehensive list of all non-earth origin or exotic unidentified anomalous phenomena material.'
